reason_unpromoted: ACTIVE_QUEUE has no continuity_mining-owned item, so canonical queue state was not overwritten.
completed_slice: Added an executable end-to-end contract test spanning alias occurrence scanning, normalization, and validation, including semantic preservation, conflict retention, and privacy rejection.
memory_recovered: Continuity is not the storage of a name alone. A durable occurrence must carry identity, lifecycle dimension, lifecycle status, epistemic status, source visibility, evidence strength, conflict state, and privacy boundary through every transformation stage.

claim_states.observed: The scanner, adapter, and validator can now be exercised as one deterministic pipeline using synthetic fixtures.
claim_states.inferred: Pipeline-level tests detect semantic drift that isolated stage tests cannot detect.
claim_states.proposed: Promote this test into the trusted continuity CI path and attach execution evidence.
claim_states.superseded: The prior unverified assumption that stage compatibility follows from matching schema versions.
claim_states.unresolved: Trusted execution of the new pipeline test has not yet been observed.

contradictions_resolved: A private source can be continuity evidence without storing its passage: a summary reference plus hash preserves provenance while enforcing privacy.
Conflicting lifecycle claims are not normalized into a winner; both survive as conflict-marked occurrences pending review.
An accepted alias occurrence requires more than normalization: its evidence and review state must also remain valid after composition.

verification.limitation: No CI or local runtime execution result is claimed.

privacy_boundary: Only synthetic alias fixtures, abstract continuity rules, repository paths, dates, and commit identifiers were stored. No private conversation passage or personal/medical content was copied.
next_action: Add the pipeline test to a trusted GitHub Actions continuity job, observe its execution for the exact commit, and record the artifact or job evidence without modifying the canonical queue unless a continuity-owned item is added.
